rv.q: The score captures the cycle of protest and unity that knits together the show's message that crisis is always on the horizon but so is solidarity.
It's a show that wears its heart on its sleeve, its faults due to an excess of commitment to doing right by its ambition to paint on a broad canvas.
Through music and storytelling, the show explores themes of unity, resistance and the power of collective action, highlighting how ordinary people can shape extraordinary moments in history.
Cable Street may not pass with flying colours, but it still just about manages to scrape through.
